notes: Type-led: text stands on a photograph only on the first screen (over a veil in the page's own dark) and on portrait tiles (same veil); every slot may be empty.
The accent appears only when something is pointed at (links, rows) and as the base of the tile tints, as on the reference; it is lightened toward the ink until it reads 4.6:1 on the room.
Tenor Sans has one weight and figures with more contrast than its letters (a crossed 7); prices and telephone numbers are set in it.
A long brand name is set smaller (from 27 letters) and may take two lines on a phone.

page_ground: always dark: the darker of palette.ground / palette.ink becomes the room, the lighter the ink (the reference is a dark page; see NOTES.md, 'Colour'). A client who must stay on a white page should not be offered this template.

best_with: 1 to 3 wide photographs from 1300 px (ratio 1.2 or wider) for the slideshow; 1 upright photograph from 600 px wide, or any from 760 px high, beside the firm's own words; 2 more from 720 x 360 for the dim pictures over the services and the people; 1 from 1000 x 600 behind the contact block; square portraits from 362 px (shown 320 square, whole)

picture_share_case: our page is 4.8 (law1) and 3.5 (person1) times the reference's home page, so the share is compared over the sections on both (first screen, index, foot): 80 / 6 against the reference's 80 / 6 / 0 per screen. Rule (3) of the contract (a picture band every two screens of list) is NOT applied: law1 has no unused photograph large enough; person1's remaining ones are under 1100 px.
